purpose: internal completion search record; not a model and not production

searchAudit.strictFeatureTiming: same-day results are added only after every prediction/selection for that date has been fixed
historicalFeatures: horse/jockey/trainer chronological win and top3 records
assigned weight, horse weight and weight change
modelFamiliesTried: LightGBM LambdaRank and rank_xendcg expanding-window ranking

staticPatternUpperBound.note: These numbers were selected after observing the development payouts and are therefore diagnostics only, not valid candidates.

strictTransferCheck.method: choose rules from 2024-05-04..2025-04-30 only, then freeze and evaluate 2025-05-01..2026-04-30
strictTransferCheck.interpretation: static high-ROI rank patterns did not transfer

bestFullyChronologicalOnlinePortfolio.decisionRule: each date is selected and bet using only statistics available before that date; all same-date outcomes are incorporated only afterwards

dataLimitation.description: For most of the frozen historical archive, race_name is a placeholder and conditions/surface/distance are missing, so race distance/surface/class cannot be reconstructed from the stored pre-race fields without inference or external repair.

conclusion.reason: No leakage-safe development policy found in this search reaches the mandatory 200% ROI in every course. The apparent 200%+ static patterns fail forward transfer and are rejected rather than promoted.
conclusion.holdoutAction: untouched because the development completion gate did not pass
